answer: Give every new identity a velvet rope, not a wall: it starts with zero weight and earns trust only by staking a deposit that grows with each verified job. A single comet of fake accounts burns out fast, because each Sybil must post its own bond and complete real, paid work before it can vote or transact, while pigment-tagged reputation trails make coordinated fakes visible at a glance. Forging a thousand identities then costs a thousand bonds and a thousand jobs — more than any attacker gains.
